data.one_liner: Unified in-app inspector for logs, network, navigation and database events.
data.what_it_does: It captures and displays logs, HTTP traffic, navigation actions and database operations in a single overlay, with filtering, bookmarking and export features.
use_when: Need quick debugging of network and log issues without external tools
Want to trace navigation flows and database changes during QA
Require a single API to access multiple devtools
avoid_when: You only need simple logging or network inspection, not a full overlay
Your app targets only web or only native and you prefer platform-specific tools
weaknesses: Large feature set may be overkill for simple projects
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec, call FlutterInspectorKit.initialize() in main(), optionally enable captureHttpClient:true
